newsitem.title: USA: Cancer Treatment to open bone marrow center.
newsitem.headline: Cancer Treatment to open bone marrow center.

text.p: Cancer Treatment Holdings Inc said on Thursday it plans to open its second bone marrow transplant center in a joint venture with Baptist Hospital in Pensacola, Florida.
The company said the program has received a certificate of need from the State of Florida. Its first center is in Hollywood, Florida.
In the transplant process, cancer patients have stem cells, a component of bone marrow, removed from their blood and returned to them after high-dose chemotherapy.
Cancer Treatment said it expects construction for the Pensacola center to be complete in 30 to 90 days.
